patterns.description: El umbral de primera venta co-ocurre con la exclusión de productos de Gumroad Discover: SC-R1-055 y SC-R1-062 se concentran en documentar que sin la primera venta, Discover no distribuye los productos del vendedor. El elemento bloqueante y lo bloqueado aparecen documentados en múltiples cartas.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-055: Blog states Gumroad will not promote through Discover until seller earns first $10
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller forum: 26 products with zero Discover views; attributes zero discovery to Discover requiring first sale before showing products
signal_summaries.SC-R1-073: Help center: products listed on Discover once unspecified eligibility criteria satisfied and category selected
signal_summaries.SC-R1-069: Help center: adding category and tags helps Gumroad show products on Discover

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-055 actor=seller, SC-R1-062 actor=seller, SC-R1-073 actor=seller, SC-R1-069 actor=seller. All signal IDs across both poles share the same actor value (seller). Routed rejected_grouping, reason: same_actor_discrepancy.

components.label: Blocking element: first-sale threshold gates Discover access
components.summary: Two cards document that Discover does not show new seller products until the first $10 earned or first sale is made

components.label: Blocked: organic discovery and traffic from Discover for new sellers
components.summary: Three cards document that Discover is the platform organic discovery channel but access is blocked for sellers who have not met the first-sale threshold

patterns.description: La restricción de pago en ciertos países co-ocurre con la incapacidad de cobrar ventas realizadas: SC-R1-024 y SC-R1-028 se concentran en documentar que para vendedores en países sin depósito directo ni PayPal, no hay mecanismo de pago disponible. Lo bloqueado aparece en SC-R1-027 que documenta la capacidad de aceptar pagos en 160+ países.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-024: Help center: if direct deposit and PayPal both unavailable, there is currently no way to pay the seller
signal_summaries.SC-R1-028: Help center: if PayPal not supported in seller's country, Gumroad cannot pay them; Payoneer, wire, bitcoin listed as unavailable
signal_summaries.SC-R1-025: Help center: PayPal payouts in USD only; Payoneer, Wise, check, money order, wire transfer not supported
signal_summaries.SC-R1-027: Help center: creators in 160+ countries can accept payments on Gumroad

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-024 actor=seller, SC-R1-028 actor=seller, SC-R1-025 actor=seller, SC-R1-027 actor=seller. All signal IDs across both poles share the same actor value (seller). Routed rejected_grouping, reason: same_actor_discrepancy.

components.label: Blocking element: no payout method available for sellers in unsupported countries
components.summary: Three cards document that sellers in countries without direct deposit or PayPal support have no payout path; alternatives (Payoneer, Wise, wire, bitcoin) explicitly listed as unavailable

components.label: Blocked: seller ability to receive payment despite platform operating in their country
components.summary: Card documents platform operates in 160+ countries for payment acceptance, but payout availability is constrained by a separate set of supported countries

patterns.description: La retención de fondos durante suspensión de cuenta co-ocurre con la incapacidad del vendedor de acceder a su balance: SC-R1-029 documenta el mecanismo de retención de 30-45 días; SC-R1-046 co-ocurre con relatos de vendedores que no pudieron recuperar su dinero tras suspensión.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-029: Help center: account suspension for high chargeback rate holds balance 30-45 days; remaining balance paid if banking partner grants clearance
signal_summaries.SC-R1-046: Blog: many Gumroad users faced delayed payouts and account suspensions without clear reasons; some struggled to get their money back

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-029 actor=seller, SC-R1-046 actor=seller. All signal IDs across both poles share the same actor value (seller). Routed rejected_grouping, reason: same_actor_discrepancy.

components.label: Blocking element: account suspension holds seller balance 30-45 days
components.summary: Official help center documents suspension process: balance held 30-45 days, released only if banking partner grants clearance

components.label: Blocked: seller access to earned balance during and after suspension
components.summary: Blog commentary documents sellers struggling to recover funds after suspension events

patterns.description: La restricción de formato de archivo de productos gratuitos co-ocurre con limitaciones para creadores que distribuyen contenido de gran tamaño sin cobro: SC-R1-031 y SC-R1-071 se concentran en documentar que el límite de 250 MB aplica a productos gratuitos mientras que productos de pago permiten hasta 16 GB.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-031: Help center: free products 250 MB limit; products above $0.99 have 16 GB per-file limit
signal_summaries.SC-R1-071: Help center: free products 250 MB limit; products above $0.99 have 16 GB per-file limit

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-031 actor=seller, SC-R1-071 actor=seller. All signal IDs across both poles share the same actor value (seller). Routed rejected_grouping, reason: same_actor_discrepancy.

components.label: Blocking element: 250 MB file size cap on free products
components.summary: Two cards (same source) document the 250 MB file size limit specifically applying to free products

components.label: Blocked: distribution of large files via free products
components.summary: Same cards document that paid products above $0.99 allow 16 GB per file, making the 250 MB limit specifically a constraint on the free product tier

patterns.description: La política de cambios abruptos en artículos prohibidos co-ocurre con la incapacidad del vendedor de anticipar restricciones: SC-R1-014 documenta que cambios a la lista de productos prohibidos ocurren sin aviso y con efecto inmediato; SC-R1-016 co-ocurre con la discreción exclusiva de Gumroad para cambiar categorías elegibles.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-014: Policy page: changes to prohibited items list may occur abruptly and without notice due to unpredictable card network rules; changes take effect immediately
signal_summaries.SC-R1-016: ToS: Gumroad holds sole discretion to determine and change eligible product categories for resale at any time
signal_summaries.SC-R1-012: Policy page: prohibited items are disallowed because they violate US federal law, card network rules, or payment processor restrictions

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-014 actor=marketplace, SC-R1-016 actor=seller, SC-R1-012 actor=marketplace. Not all same actor (marketplace + seller). Filter does not apply. Blocking element: abrupt no-notice policy changes and sole discretion to change eligible categories (SC-R1-014, SC-R1-016). What is blocked: seller ability to plan and maintain product listings in a stable policy environment (SC-R1-012, SC-R1-014). Both sides documented across 3 cards from 2 source URLs. Mechanism is clear.

components.label: Blocking element: abrupt no-notice policy changes and sole discretion to change eligible categories
components.summary: Two cards document that prohibited items changes take effect immediately without notice, and that Gumroad holds sole discretion to change eligible product categories at any time

components.label: Blocked: seller ability to maintain product listings in stable policy environment
components.summary: Two cards document the mechanism of prohibition (US federal law, card network rules, payment processor restrictions) and its unpredictable nature

patterns.description: La política de reembolso a discreción de Gumroad co-ocurre con la obligación del vendedor de reembolsar a Gumroad: SC-R1-034 y SC-R1-018 se concentran en documentar que Gumroad puede emitir reembolsos anulando la política del vendedor y que el vendedor debe cubrir esos montos. SC-R1-037 documenta que el comprador puede iniciar chargebacks en cualquier momento.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-034: Help center: Gumroad reserves right to issue refunds within 90 days even if seller has no-refund policy, to prevent chargebacks
signal_summaries.SC-R1-018: ToS: Gumroad handles refunds/chargebacks at sole discretion; sellers must reimburse Gumroad for any amounts paid to buyers
signal_summaries.SC-R1-037: Help center: customers have specified amount of time (usually 90 days) to request chargeback; Gumroad as merchant cannot prevent chargebacks

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-034 actor=seller, SC-R1-018 actor=seller, SC-R1-037 actor=buyer. Not all same actor (seller + buyer). Filter does not apply. Note: SC-R1-076 referenced in prior run does not exist in the card index (only 75 cards, SC-R1-001 through SC-R1-075); excluded. Remaining 3 verified cards document the friction: blocking element (Gumroad and buyer can initiate reversals regardless of seller policy) and blocked element (seller ability to enforce no-refund policy and retain revenue) are both documented. Both sides have documented support.

components.label: Blocking element: Gumroad and buyer can initiate refunds/chargebacks regardless of seller policy
components.summary: Two cards document that Gumroad can override seller no-refund policy within 90 days, and buyers can request chargebacks through their credit card; Gumroad as merchant cannot prevent chargebacks

components.label: Blocked: seller ability to enforce no-refund policy and retain revenue from completed sales
components.summary: Two cards document that sellers must reimburse Gumroad for refund and chargeback amounts, making seller revenue from any sale reversible regardless of stated policy
